module_summary: AXI-stream broadcaster: one input beat is registered in an output stage replicated to M_COUNT outputs, with a skid (temp) register and registered ready so input waits until all outputs accept.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: input beat valid, copied into per-output valid vector

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: input payload stored to output or temp register

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: per-output valid vector, cleared per output as each accepts

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: per-output ready; all must accept before next beat

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: output data register replicated to all outputs

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: skid register holding input beat while outputs stall

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: skid register occupied; gates ready_early and temp-to-output transfer

anchors.name: store_axis_input_to_output
anchors.why: loads input beat into output registers

anchors.name: store_axis_input_to_temp
anchors.why: loads input beat into skid registers

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: moves skid register contents to output registers

groups.name: Output register stage
groups.description: Output registers broadcast to all M_COUNT ports with per-port valid

groups.name: Skid buffer
groups.description: Temp registers capture input when outputs not ready

groups.name: Input ready control
groups.description: Registered ready computed from output acceptance and skid occupancy
